status: Retrospective candidate review; written before these new calculations, after the original selection and lesion outcomes were known.
question: How distinct are the four eligible candidates, and how dependent is the selection on support and pooled recruitment conventions?
inputs: Saved exploratory80 eigenpairs, mode table and membership; original five-selection-trial features; existing signed connectivity.
checks: Verify original feature and connectivity hashes; unique exact neuron IDs; reconstruct every original first-40 stable complete mode support and recruitment value.
Recompute residuals for all four eligible candidates against the signed matrix, without solving new eigenpairs.

For all first 40 stable complete modes, examine support fractions 0.50, 0.75 and 0.90 crossed with pooled spike thresholds 1, 5 and 10, retaining at least ten qualifying cells and sensory exclusion. Preserve original ranking by whole-vector recruited power, magnitude and rank.

Report all four original candidates, their annotations, model signs, pooled recruitment, number active in all five selection trials, and pairwise support and active-support overlaps. Retain missing annotations explicitly.
interpretation: No new significance tests, biological cutoff, candidate substitution or lesion simulation. Same-data sensitivity cannot establish independent selection or outcome generalization. Existing two-solver stability flags are inherited, not independently rerun.
